name: Code Agent CLIs
description: Installs AI coding-agent CLIs into the workspace: Claude Code (claude), OpenAI Codex (codex), GitHub Copilot CLI (copilot), and Cursor's cursor-agent. Pure command installs, no login/settings/secrets bundled here — each CLI still needs its own auth (e.g. `claude login`, `codex login`, `copilot`, `cursor-agent login`) run from a workspace terminal before use.

apps.reason: claude/codex/copilot are npm-published packages, installed through the Node.js dev toolkit (nvm/node/npm) that the essentials app owns — it must be installed/loaded first.

dependencies.note: Runtime-enforced app dependency: aw-workspace installs/loads essentials before code-agent-clis and keeps essentials loaded while code-agent-clis is desired.
